description.zh:
驱动ID。在[边缘计算控制台](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list)的**驱动管理**页面中，鼠标悬浮在目标驱动名称上获取ID。

您也可以调用[QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~)接口获取。
description.en:
The driver ID. To obtain the ID, go to the **Driver Management** page in the [Edge Computing console](https://iot.console.aliyun.com/le/instance/list), and move the mouse pointer over the target driver name.

You can also call the [QueryEdgeDriver](~~155776~~) API to obtain the driver ID.

description.zh: 实例ID。公共实例不传此参数，企业版实例需传入。
description.en: The instance ID. Do not specify this parameter for public instances. Specify this parameter for Enterprise instances.

title.en: Publish a specific version of a driver

descriptions.zh:
## 限制条件
单阿里云账号调用该接口的每秒请求数（QPS）最大限制为10。

> RAM用户共享主账号配额。
descriptions.en:
## Conditions
Each Alibaba Cloud account can send a maximum of 10 queries per second (QPS) to invoke this API.

> Resource Access Management (RAM) users share the quota of the Alibaba Cloud account.
